name: orbex-sonar-ds
description: Orbex Sonar-DB Design System: tokens, components and documentation.
author: 988©STUDIO

scripts.build: npm run build -w @orbex/sonar-tokens && npm run build -w @orbex/sonar-components && npm run build -w site
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @orbex/sonar-tokens && npm run build -w @orbex/sonar-components && npm run dev -w site
scripts.test: npm run build -w @orbex/sonar-tokens && npm test -w @orbex/sonar-tokens && npm test -w @orbex/sonar-components
scripts.check: npm run typecheck -w @orbex/sonar-tokens && npm run typecheck -w @orbex/sonar-components && npm run typecheck -w @orbex/sonar-patterns && npm run check -w site
